info.name: Azure Monitor List metrics at subscription scope

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Client API version.

params.name: region
params.description: The region where the metrics you want reside.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan of the query in ISO 8601 duration format (startDateTime_ISO/endDateTime_ISO).

params.name: interval
params.description: The interval (window size) of the query in ISO 8601 duration format.

params.name: metricnames
params.description: The names of the metrics (comma-separated) to retrieve. Maximum of 20.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: The list of aggregation types (comma-separated) to retrieve.

params.name: $filter
params.description: The $filter is used to reduce the set of metric data returned. Uses OData filter expressions.

params.name: top
params.description: The maximum number of records to retrieve. Defaults to 10.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The aggregation to use for sorting results and the direction of the sort.

params.name: resultType
params.description: Reduces the set of data collected. Data or Metadata.

params.name: metricNamespace
params.description: Metric namespace to query metric definitions for.

params.name: AutoAdjustTimegrain
params.description: If set to true, the time grain is automatically adjusted based on the timespan.

params.name: ValidateDimensions
params.description: If set to false, invalid filter parameter values will be ignored.

params.name: rollUpBy
params.description: Dimension name(s) to rollup results by.

items.docs: Lists the metric values for a subscription. The $filter parameter is used to reduce the set of metric data returned. Only some dimensions are available for subscriptions.

info.name: Azure Monitor List metrics at subscription scope via POST

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Client API version.

params.name: region
params.description: The region where the metrics you want reside.

items.docs: Lists the metric values for a subscription using a POST request. Allows the same filtering as the GET variant but with a request body for complex queries.
